purpose: Sample size as a function of how far a neighbouring year's World Bank Gini may be borrowed when the exact year is absent.
notes: The upstream macro panel and WDI publish the same construct; on 2,200 overlapping cells the relation is exactly affine with zero residual, so the backfill changes scale, not meaning.
Every recovered cell borrowed a neighbouring year: there were no exact-year recoveries at any window, so the gain is entirely a temporal-proximity decision and must be reported as such.
Window 0 is the pre-expansion panel and is retained as the conservative baseline in every downstream artifact.
